Package de.abas.ceks.jedp.query

This package contains interfaces and classes to process EDP queries for data and metadata.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    DataRecordQuery
    This interface denotes query classes which provide abas data records in their result.
    EDPQueryExecutor
    Describes query executor, i.e. an instance which executes instances of EDPQueryDescriptor providing instances of EDPQueryResult.
    EDPQueryResult
    Provides the interface to traverse through EDP result sets.
    EDPQueryResultFieldSet
    Set of fields for a query result.
    FieldListEnabledQuery
    Interface to indicate that a query descriptor class is field list enabled.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    DatabaseCommandQuery
    Describes a database command query, i.e. a query on all valid database commands.
    DatabaseQuery
    Describes a query on the existing databases.
    DataQuery
    Describes a data query.
    DataTypeQuery
    Describes a query which provides information on existing data types.
    EDPQueryDescriptor
    Base class for all query types.
    EnumerationItemQuery
    Describes a query on the items of an enumeration.
    EnumerationQuery
    Describes an enumeration query, i.e. a query on all enumeration types defined in abas ERP.
    FieldQuery
    Describes a query on the fields of: a table a database group or group set the qroup set of a reference type an infosystem a stored procedure
    FieldRelatedEDPQueryDescriptor
    Abstract base class for all queries which can be executed field related.
    GroupQuery
    Describes a group query, i.e. a query on all or a particular set of database groups.
    InfosystemQuery
    Describes a query on the available infosystems.
    KeyQuery
    Describes a query on the available database indexes (keys) for a table.
    MessageQuery
    Describes a query on message numbers and message texts.
    ProcedureExecutionQuery
    Class to execute a stored procedure and fetch the result.
    ProcedureExecutionQuery.ActualProcedureParam
    Describes an actual procedure parameter for a procedure execution query.
    ProcedureQuery
    Describes a query on existing stored procedures.
    ReadRecordQuery
    Describes a query where record a being read using their ID.
    ReferenceInfoQuery
    Describes a query which provides Information on reference types, especially which groups can be addressed by references of given type.
    TableQuery
    Describes a query on the available tables.
    TestFieldValueQuery
    Describes a query to test field values.
    TypedCommandQuery
    Describes a query which provides information on typed commands.
    VariableReferenceTypeQuery
    Describes a query which provides information on existing variable types.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    DatabaseCommandQuery.ObjectMode
    Values for the object mode field of a database command query.
    FieldQuery.FieldListType
    Type of field list to be queried. tableName must be given appropriately, e.g it must refer to an infosystem if field list type is FieldQuery.FieldListType.INFOSYS_FIELDS.
    GroupQuery.GroupQueryType
    Enum for variants of group query result scope.

Package de.abas.ceks.jedp.query Description

This package contains interfaces and classes to process EDP queries for data and metadata. They replace the deprecated class EDPQuery.

Since:
abas Version 10.2, EDP Version 2.1
